name: buildcord
description: Build and change Discord bots in Buildcord by describing what they should do.

interface.longDescription:
Build and change Discord bots by describing what they should do. Buildcord turns your request into flows: slash commands, replies to things that happen in your server, schedules, buttons and forms, each made of steps like sending a message, giving a role or saving data. You can make a bot, add and edit its flows, design embeds, buttons and modals, and keep data in variables and collections. A card shows the bot's flows and draws any flow as a diagram, with a link to open it in the Buildcord builder.

Every change is checked and saved to the bot's draft. Nothing reaches Discord until you deploy it from the builder. Your bot's token and other secrets are set in the builder too; they're never asked for or shown in the chat. Deleting a flow or a design is only done when you ask, and the app confirms first.

You need a Buildcord account. The app can only see and change the bots your account owns or that have been shared with it.
defaultPrompt: Make my Discord bot a /ping command that replies with Pong
Welcome new members with an embed that greets them by name
Show me my bot's flows and what's wrong with them

positive.prompt: What Discord bots do I have in Buildcord?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's bots by name, including Demo bot, says whether each one is live, and links to open it in Buildcord.

positive.description: Show a bot and one of its flows in the card
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows Demo bot's flows grouped by kind, with a problem count on /hello. Selecting /ping in the card draws it as a diagram, with a button to open it in Buildcord.

positive.prompt: Add a /roll command to Demo bot that replies with a random number from 1 to 6
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a /roll command whose reply shows a random number from 1 to 6, reports that it has no problems, and draws it in the card with a link to the builder. It says the bot needs deploying from the builder for the command to go live.

positive.prompt: What's wrong with Demo bot? Fix it.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains in plain words that the reply in /hello has no message, writes one, and confirms the flow has no problems left.

positive.description: Design an embed and send it when someone joins
positive.prompt: Make Demo bot DM new members a welcome embed that greets them by name
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a welcome embed that uses the member's name, adds a flow that runs when a member joins and sends it to them as a direct message, and links to both in the builder.

negative.description: Deploying is done in the builder, not from the chat. The app should say so and give the link to the bot, without calling any tool that changes it.
negative.prompt: Deploy Demo bot to Discord now.

negative.description: Bot tokens are never taken in the chat. The app should decline to store it, tell the person to add the token in the builder, and suggest they reset it in Discord's developer portal since it was shared.
negative.prompt: Here's my bot token, save it to Demo bot: MTIzNDU2Nzg5MDEyMzQ1Njc4OQ.GaBcDe.not-a-real-token

negative.description: The app builds bots; it can't act in a Discord server directly. It should explain that it can build a /ban command for the bot instead, and not change anything unless asked.
negative.prompt: Ban the member called spammer123 from my Discord server right now.

review.commerce_description: Buildcord doesn't sell anything in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: build and change Discord bots from the chat, with a card that shows a bot's flows and draws each one as a diagram.
